eyebrow.zh: 在本地种下主机名与假凭证诱饵，用 DNS/TCP 传感器记录触发，并生成可验证的报告。
eyebrow.en: Plant local hostname and fake-credential decoys, record touches with DNS/TCP sensors and produce verifiable reports.

headline.zh: 把诱饵触发变成可检查的记录。
headline.en: Turn a decoy touch into a checkable event.

sub.zh: 在本地种下主机名与假凭证诱饵，用 DNS/TCP 传感器记录触发，并生成可验证的报告。
sub.en: Plant local hostname and fake-credential decoys, record touches with DNS/TCP sensors and produce verifiable reports.

caption.en: An illustrative component scene; recorded output appears below.

body.zh: DNS、TCP 和日志都由本机管理。
body.en: DNS, TCP and logs remain locally managed.

body.zh: 用部署密钥检查 HMAC 完整性。
body.en: Check HMAC integrity with the deployment key.

body.zh: 在无法直接检查 Agent 内部行为的环境里，诱饵提供了一个具体观察点：是否有请求触碰到预先安排的值。CanaryProbe 把触发来源、时间和传感器类型写进本地审计记录，供部署者结合运行场景判断。
body.en: When an agent’s internals are unavailable, a decoy gives operators a concrete observation point: did a request touch a planted value? CanaryProbe records the source, timestamp and sensor type locally so operators can interpret the event in its deployment context.

body.zh: 脚本创建临时诱饵，向真实本地 DNS 传感器发送一次查询，再校验报告和清单。没有启动 Coding Agent，也未测试外部网络；生成的主机名、端口与时间会随运行变化。
body.en: The script plants temporary decoys, sends one query to a real local DNS sensor and verifies the report and manifest. It launches no coding agent and tests no external network. Generated hostnames, ports and timestamps vary between runs.

alt.en: The script plants temporary decoys, sends one query to a real local DNS sensor and verifies the report and manifest. It launches no coding agent and tests no external network. Generated hostnames, ports and timestamps vary between runs.

body.zh: init 生成诱饵、部署配置与 HMAC 清单。watch 在一个进程里运行权威 DNS 与 TCP 传感器，触发后向 audit.jsonl 追加事件；report 读取事件和清单生成带 HMAC 的 Markdown，verify 用同一部署密钥重新计算。
body.en: init creates decoys, deployment configuration and an HMAC manifest. watch runs authoritative DNS and TCP sensors in one process and appends events to audit.jsonl. report reads events and the manifest to produce HMAC-signed Markdown; verify recomputes signatures using the deployment key.

alt.zh: init 生成诱饵、部署配置与 HMAC 清单。watch 在一个进程里运行权威 DNS 与 TCP 传感器，触发后向 audit.jsonl 追加事件；report 读取事件和清单生成带 HMAC 的 Markdown，verify 用同一部署密钥重新计算。
alt.en: init creates decoys, deployment configuration and an HMAC manifest. watch runs authoritative DNS and TCP sensors in one process and appends events to audit.jsonl. report reads events and the manifest to produce HMAC-signed Markdown; verify recomputes signatures using the deployment key.

body.zh: 默认 DNS 绑定 127.0.0.1:5353，TCP 绑定 127.0.0.1:5443。必须让实际测试流量到达这些传感器；单独修改 /etc/hosts 不会把 DNS 查询导向 5353。
body.en: Default binds are 127.0.0.1:5353 for DNS and 127.0.0.1:5443 for TCP. Tested traffic must reach those listeners; editing /etc/hosts alone does not route DNS queries to port 5353.

body.zh: deployment.yaml 统一管理 `decoy_zone`、`dns_sensor.host/port`、`conn_sensor.host/port`、`decoys_file`、`manifest_file` 与 `audit_file`。默认本地密钥为权限 0600 的 `.canaryprobe.key`，也可设置 `CANARYPROBE_SIGNING_KEY`。保留私有密钥；报告验证需要它。
body.en: deployment.yaml owns `decoy_zone`, `dns_sensor.host/port`, `conn_sensor.host/port`, `decoys_file`, `manifest_file` and `audit_file`. The local key defaults to `.canaryprobe.key` with mode 0600; `CANARYPROBE_SIGNING_KEY` overrides it. Keep the key private; report verification needs it.

note.zh: 脚本创建临时诱饵，向真实本地 DNS 传感器发送一次查询，再校验报告和清单。没有启动 Coding Agent，也未测试外部网络；生成的主机名、端口与时间会随运行变化。
note.en: The script plants temporary decoys, sends one query to a real local DNS sensor and verifies the report and manifest. It launches no coding agent and tests no external network. Generated hostnames, ports and timestamps vary between runs.

body.zh: DNS 返回回环地址；报告记录 1 个事件，清单与报告签名均验证成功。
body.en: DNS returns a loopback address. The report contains one event, and both manifest and report signatures verify.

steps.output:
Request: [127.0.0.1:63137] (udp) / 'ci-runner-07-91.corp.local.' (A)
Reply: [127.0.0.1:63137] (udp) / 'ci-runner-07-91.corp.local.' (A) / RRs: A
{
  "dns_answer": "127.0.0.1",
  "verdict": "TRIPPED",
  "events": 1,
  "manifest_verified": true,
  "report_verified": true
}

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+ 与 uv。演示临时绑定回环 UDP 端口，无需 root，不修改系统 DNS 或 hosts。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+ and uv. The example binds a temporary loopback UDP port without root and does not change system DNS or hosts.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/canaryprobe.git
cd canaryprobe
uv venv --python 3.12
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .

limitations.zh: CLEAN 只表示读取的日志中没有触发，不能证明系统没有外联。TRIPPED 也不单独证明恶意或成功外泄。
limitations.en: CLEAN means no trips were found in the read log; it does not prove absence of egress. TRIPPED alone does not prove malice or successful exfiltration.

limitations.zh: HMAC 使用共享密钥，属于完整性检查；持有密钥的人可生成报告。日志不是不可修改的存储。
limitations.en: HMAC uses a shared key for integrity checking; anyone holding the key can generate reports. The log is not immutable storage.

changelog.note: fix: version drift — package metadata surfaces (__init__.py + pyproject.toml) now move in lockstep with the VERSION file and the release tag, so `canaryprobe --version` reports the true release and a built wheel no longer collides with a prior release's version. Backfilled the missing v0.8.0 changelog entry for traceability.

refresh: content re-verified for v0.8.0 (fix-yaml-tab-indent-silent-wrong-bind — tab-indented sensor blocks no longer silently drop host/port, so a mis-indented canary no longer binds loopback and never fires).
